mapper.insert: insert into setmeal (name, category_id, price, status, image, description, create_time, create_user, update_time, update_user) values (#{name}, #{categoryId}, #{price}, #{status}, #{image}, #{description}, #{createTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateTime}, #{updateUser})
mapper.select: select count(id) from setmeal where category_id = #{id}
select sd.name, sd.copies, d.image, d.description from setmeal_dish sd left join dish d on sd.dish_id = d.id where sd.setmeal_id = #{setmealId}
